# Building the canvas: one pilot feature, one deferred design feature, three documents

**Date:** 2026-09-05 · **Repo:** apivo-news @ origin/main `20de06c` · **Canvas:** 26 artboards, "epiloYES in evreos"

Everything below was verified against `origin/main` (and `origin/xcoder/cashback-web` for PR #493) during this session. Where the three input proposals disagreed, the resolution is stated inline with the evidence.

Plan file: `C:\Users\madym\.claude\plans\so-now-that-i-m-drifting-waterfall-agent-ad9871e3f4862b588.md`

---

## 0. The five verified facts that decide the shape

| # | Fact | Verified by | Consequence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Member authentication already exists on the backend.** `internal/identity/{verifier,service,role}.go` verifies Supabase JWTs and resolves the subject to an `account` row; `internal/cashback/{wallet,clickout,catalogue,payout,ops}/auth.go` each gate every route behind a `MemberAuthenticator` that takes the member **from the token and never from the path**; `cmd/apivo/main.go` wires all of it. | `git ls-tree origin/main internal/identity/`, `internal/cashback/*/auth.go` | Proposal 3 is right and Proposals 1 and 2 are **wrong**: "member identity does not exist" is false. What is missing is the *frontend* half (a member session module) and *account-row provisioning*. That is days, not a feature. |
| 2 | **No production path inserts an `account` row.** `git grep "insert into account" origin/main -- internal` matches only `_test.go` files. `identity.ErrUnknownAccount` is documented as "authenticated with Supabase but was never provisioned here" → 401. | `git grep`, `internal/identity/service.go:16` | A member who signs up with Supabase today gets a valid token and a 401 everywhere. Provisioning is on the critical path. |
| 3 | **`BRAND_DIR` gates the money path.** `cmd/apivo/main.go:779` logs *"BRAND_DIR is unset, so this deployment has no brand definition: members cannot opt into cashback and POST /api/v1/cashback/participation will answer 503"*, and line 791 fails when the brand defines no terms document. | `cmd/apivo/main.go:763–795` | The legal documents are **not** a compliance chore beside the product; they are a precondition of opt-in, enforced today. This collapses "legal pages" and "brand seam" into one blocking prerequisite. |
| 4 | **`docs/adr/0005-cashback-stack.md` already exists.** | `git ls-tree origin/main docs/adr/` | Proposals 2 and 3 both proposed writing ADR **0005** — both wrong. Next free numbers are **0006** and **0007**. |
| 5 | **The pilot has a date.** `docs/master-prompts/evreos-browser.md`: *"The partner's new shop opens on 1 October and cannot wait for a browser. The pilot runs on the existing web surfaces."* Cohort: a German orthopaedic shop, thousands of patients, a partner-funded price-lock programme. | that file, lines ~37–45 | **26 days from today.** The canvas is a secondary artefact. |

Supporting facts also verified: `web/src/styles/modernist.css` contains **exactly 39** hex-bearing lines against a `scripts/lint-brand-literals.sh` budget of **exactly 39** (`awk` verdict `if (count > allowed) FAIL`); `web/src/styles/contrast.test.ts:16` uses `css.match(new RegExp(...))` — non-global, **first match wins**; `.specify/scripts/bash/create-new-feature.sh` contains **no `git checkout`** and only prints `export SPECIFY_FEATURE=` (spec-kit numbering is a directory label, not a git ref); `specs/` on main holds 001, 002, 004 (003 arrives with PR #493); 004 has **59 open / 9 done** tasks; `web/src/middleware.ts` serves disallow-all `robots.txt`, stamps `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow`, and 403s crawler user-agents; `web/src/pages/[lang]/register.astro` has every field `disabled`; `wallet.astro:73` calls `editorSession(Astro.request)` and passes `session.token` — **the member wallet is authenticated by the editor identity.**

### The disagreements, resolved in one sentence each

- **Member auth exists or not?** Proposal 3 is right — the Go side is built and gate-tested; only the browser session and provisioning are missing.
- **One feature or four?** Neither extreme: **two** — Proposal 1's single feature would put a legally-gated money path behind a CSS token swap, and Proposal 2's split of "legal" from "identity" severs one causal chain (no brand → no opt-in → no wallet → nothing to sign into).
- **Task numbering `T300–T399` or a letter prefix?** Letter prefix — 004 is live at T200–T294 with 59 open and `speckit-converge` free to append, so a numeric range is a hostage to another feature's growth.
- **ADR number?** 0006 and 0007; Proposal 1 alone got this right.
- **Dark theme now or later?** Later — but Proposal 1's *internal ordering* (teach `contrast.test.ts` blocks and one level of `var()` **before** a single dark value lands) is a correctness ordering that holds regardless of any date and must be carried into the deferred feature verbatim.
- **Build the evreos seam?** No — all three proposals agree, and the constitution's out-of-scope list is a do-not-scaffold list, not a not-yet list.

---

## 1. Scope boundary — all 26 artboards, counted

**26 total = 17 apivo-news · 6 wholly evreos · 2 mixed · 1 documentation.**

### 1a. Wholly evreos — build nothing, ever, in this repo (6)

`LauncherClosed` · `LauncherOpen` · `LauncherDesktop` · `HomeMobile` · `HomeDesktop` · `Assistant`

`docs/master-prompts/evreos-browser.md` line 3: *"Planning artifact only. Nothing in this file is in scope for `apivo-news`."* The constitution (`.specify/memory/constitution.md:380–385`) lists "browser extension, mobile apps … or any further ecosystem mini-app" and, separately, **search** — which is why the `Αναζήτηση` rail item on `NewsDesktop` is also refused.

Explicitly **not** to be built as a consequence: `web/src/lib/shell/manifest.ts`, `web/src/pages/api/shell/summary.ts`, any `--shell-*` token in `modernist.css`, any `assistant.context` sender, any shell chrome component.

### 1b. Mixed — module side only (2)

- **`Main.dc.html`** — the shell chrome half is evreos's. The module half is eight contract items, of which **three are already built and must be re-exported, never restated**: `Money` (`web/src/lib/cashback/money.ts`), `Axes` (`web/src/lib/reader/axes.ts`), deep links (`web/src/lib/cashback/paths.ts`). The other five (insets, theme handoff, identity exchange, bridge, viewport-fit) become **ADR 0006**, not code.
- **`AssistantDraft.dc.html`** — columns 1 and 3 are evreos's. **Column 2 is in scope and is real work**: `withdraw.astro` renders only `t.approvalStep2`; `approvalStep1` and `approvalStep3` are catalogued in `el` and `de` and referenced nowhere (`git grep approvalStep1` returns only the definition).

The strongest single finding across all six input reports belongs here and needs **no code**: `internal/platform/db/migrations/0014_cashback_payout.up.sql` declares `approved_by uuid not null references public.account (id)`, tightened to the operator role by 0019 — an assistant that is not an account row *cannot* approve a payout. The only action is a thing not to do (never insert a machine row into `public.account`), recorded in ADR 0002.

### 1c. Documentation, never a route (1)

`SettingsSeam.dc.html` — drawn dark and in English while its neighbours are light and Greek, because it is a decision board. It becomes **ADR 0007** and must never appear under `web/src/pages/`.

### 1d. apivo-news work (17), by build state

| State | Count | Artboards |
|---|---|---|
| **Built on `main`** — delta only | 4 | NewsMobile, ArticleMobile, NewsDesktop, ArticleDesktop |
| **Built on PR #493** — delta only | 5 | WalletMobile, WalletDesktop, CatalogueMobile, CatalogueDesktop, MerchantMobile |
| **Not built** — new routes | 6 boards → 5 routes | SignIn, Profile, ProfileDesktop *(one route, one file, a breakpoint)*, Settings, LegalDesktop, Faq |
| **Design system, no route** | 2 | Palette (Dark Modernist), Theme |

### 1e. The pilot cut — 6 in, 11 deferred

**On the 1 October critical path (6):** LegalDesktop, SignIn, WalletMobile, CatalogueMobile, MerchantMobile, WalletDesktop *(minimal: the approval-disclosure box only)*.

**Deferred to feature 006 (11):** Palette, Theme, Profile, ProfileDesktop, Settings, Faq, CatalogueDesktop, and all four news boards.

---

## 2. Spec-kit structure

Two features. Verified mechanics: `create-new-feature.sh` computes highest-existing `specs/NNN-` **+1**, creates a directory, writes `.specify/feature.json`, and prints `export SPECIFY_FEATURE=` — it creates **no git branch**. Real branches stay `xcoder/<slug>` (Principle I, enforced by `scripts/lint-refs.sh`), one small PR per issue. Feature count therefore places **no limit at all** on parallel agents.

Numbering: highest on `main` is 004 → next is **005**. PR #493 brings `specs/003-cashback-claims`, which does not change that. After 005 exists, the next is **006**. Do **not** pass `--number`.

### Feature 005 — `specs/005-pilot-launch`

**Acceptance criterion, one sentence:** *A German patient scans a QR code at the counter, creates an account, accepts the terms, opts into cashback, clicks out to the partner, and sees a pending entry in a wallet authenticated as them.*

| | |
|---|---|
| **Task ids** | `PILOT-T001` – `PILOT-T0nn` (≈70). Letter prefix, following the `CB-` precedent. Cannot collide with T001–T035, CB-T001–CB-T147, T148–T192 or T200–T29x, and cannot be broken by 004 extending its range. |
| **Milestone** | `M-PILOT` — feature freeze **25 Sep 2026**, live **1 Oct 2026** |
| **In scope** | a real brand definition deployed as `BRAND_DIR`; the member half of the existing Supabase session; account-row provisioning; terms acceptance and cashback opt-in; the legal pages that render the accepted documents; the four cashback member screens from #493 corrected for phone; the accent WCAG fixes; one end-to-end journey test against real Postgres |
| **Out of scope** | dark theme, typed approver/publication fields, /profile, /faq, /settings-as-a-route, place chips, category chips, the wallet timeline promotion, search, claims, everything evreos |
| **Artefacts** | `spec.md` (acceptance sentence as the sole success criterion; the pilot-shape question recorded as a clarification, not resolved) · `plan.md` · `research.md` (the two reshaping findings: member auth exists behind `internal/identity`; `BRAND_DIR` 503s participation) · `data-model.md` (brand schema additions + the provisioning path; **no migration expected — say so explicitly**) · `contracts/http-api.md` (participation / terms-acceptance delta) · `quickstart.md` (the counter runbook) · `tasks.md` · `checklists/legal-readiness.md` · `checklists/launch-readiness.md` |

### Feature 006 — `specs/006-design-system`

Specified during the pilot sprint, **implemented from 2 October**. Contains Palette, Theme, the deferred member surfaces (/profile, /faq, /settings), the news-board deltas, and the typed approver/publication contract change.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Task ids** | `DS-T001` – |
| **Milestone** | `M-DESIGN` — specified by 30 Sep, implementation opens 2 Oct |
| **Non-negotiable ordering inside it** | (1) `contrast.test.ts` made block-aware + one-level `var()` resolver as a **pure refactor**, every existing light assertion passing byte-for-byte, no stylesheet change in the same PR; (2) hoist `--paper`/`--ink` primitives **in place** so the hex-line count stays at 39, verified with `sh scripts/lint-brand-literals.sh` before commit; (3) the dark block written entirely as `var()` re-assignments, zero new hex literals; (4) the dark ratio assertions, including the two **negative** ones (accent-500 on dark surface < 4.5; accent-600 on dark bg < 4.5). |

### Governance: one amendment act, not three

Prepared by an agent via `/speckit-constitution`, ratified by the founder **once**, batching: the **PATCH** bringing Governance current with Q1 as amended 2026-09-03 (Awin + Linkwise), which 004 says is owed; and the **MINOR** adding claims plus C-8/C-9/C-10, which `specs/003-cashback-claims` is blocked on. A third clause — lifting "in-store cashback" off the out-of-scope list — is drafted **only if** founder decision #1 comes back "in-store", and that answer means 1 October is not achievable as planned.

### Documents (no feature, one small PR each)

- `docs/adr/0006-module-shell-seam.md` — the eight contract items, the three already satisfied by shipped code, the no-bridge URL fallback, the **unreconciled** inset arithmetic (44/74 on Main vs 92 above / 98 below on the launcher boards — record the ambiguity, do not resolve it), and the engine baseline. Its opening line must state that the evreos column is an assumption recorded unilaterally, not an agreement, or it will later be cited as though evreos signed it. Correct two things the boards get wrong: the engine question is already answered at `evreos-browser.md:296` (WebView2 / WKWebView / WebKitGTK) and what is open is a minimum-version QA matrix; and `:has()` is load-bearing in `modernist.css` **and eight page files**, not only the shared chrome.
- `docs/adr/0007-settings-across-the-shell-seam.md` — the three-column ownership split; the acceptance criteria for /settings whenever it is built (no theme switch, no interface-language switch, no sign-out).
- `docs/design/canvas-errata.md` — with the rule stated at the top: **where a board and a fixture disagree, the fixture wins and the board gets corrected.** Contents: `4 καταχωρίσεις` vs five `ENTRY_FIXTURES`; `6 νέα σήμερα` vs three el/munich items; `4 συγκαταθέσεις` vs three `CONSENT_FIXTURE` records; the 4% rate figure on a `WalletEntry` that carries no rate field; `naftemporia.example` → `aigaionea.example`; NewsDesktop's route → `/el/munich+greece`; `πριν 2 ώρες` → what `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat` actually renders; `brand.payout` is `{descriptor}` and does **not** carry the threshold (that is `WalletTotals.payout_threshold`); `cashback.catalogue` is not a flag in the brand fixture.

### Exact speckit invocation sequence

```
# Day 0–1, governance (founder ratifies)
/speckit-constitution           # batched PATCH + MINOR, one Sync Impact Report

# Day 1–2, the pilot feature
/speckit-specify   "Pilot launch on the existing web surfaces: a partner-referred
                    German member registers, accepts terms, opts into cashback,
                    clicks out and sees a pending entry."   # auto-numbers 005
/speckit-clarify                # run AFTER founder decision #1 is answered
/speckit-plan
/speckit-tasks                  # then hand-edit ids to the PILOT- prefix
/speckit-checklist "legal readiness: Impressum, privacy notice, terms, retention"
/speckit-checklist "launch readiness: the 25 September freeze gate"
/speckit-analyze
/speckit-taskstoissues          # ONE PHASE AT A TIME, never the whole tasks.md

# Day 20–25, the deferred feature (specified only)
/speckit-specify   "Dark Modernist and the deferred member surfaces"   # auto-numbers 006
/speckit-plan
/speckit-tasks                  # DS- prefix

# 24 September
/speckit-converge               # on 005, to catch drift before the freeze
```

---

## 3. Build order

### Day 0 — founder-serial, blocks everything

Answer decision #1 (pilot shape). Commission the three legal texts. Supply the business facts. Nothing below starts cleanly without these, and the legal texts are the **longest pole**: not much code, but the only critical-path item no agent can produce, that cannot be parallelised, and whose latency the founder does not control.

### Wave A — days 1–4, four parallel worktree agents, four small PRs

| | Work | Files |
|---|---|---|

## 5. The gates CI must prove

1. **TypeScript coverage 80%** — `web/vitest.config.ts` `include` is an explicit allowlist whose own comment is a build instruction: *"New source files with logic must be added to `include` alongside their tests."* Every new module in this plan (`lib/brand/load.ts`, `lib/member/session.ts`, `lib/faq/questions.ts`, `lib/account/profile.ts`) must be added **in the same commit** as its test, or the gate measures nothing.
2. **`web/src/styles/contrast.test.ts`** — passes today and must keep passing untouched during the pilot. For 006's dark theme it must change **first and alone**: `token()` becomes block-aware (slice the sheet at rule boundaries before matching, because `String.match` with a non-global regex returns the first occurrence), and gains a one-level `var()` resolver so `--color-bg: var(--paper)` yields `#f3f2f2` and `mixOver()` still parses a mix built from a `var()`. Then add the ten dark ratios and the **two refusals as negative assertions**. A dark block landed before this ships entirely unasserted while the gate stays green.
3. **`scripts/lint-brand-literals.sh`** (run by `.github/workflows/brand-lint.yml` on every `pull_request` and on push to main) — `modernist.css` is at **39 of 39** with zero headroom, and the script forbids its own raise in writing. Two consequences: the dark block must be literal-free `var()` re-assignments over the existing ramps; and **every new `.astro` page in this plan has no budget entry at all**, so an unlisted file fails on its **first** hex literal or its first contiguous `epiloYES` — a `<title>`, an `aria-label`, a copied split wordmark. Put that sentence in the body of every issue that creates a new page.
4. **Language/place axis rule (Principle VII)** — no fused locale anywhere. New routes guard with `isReadingLanguage` and `parseAxes`; all member-facing text goes in catalogues keyed by the BCP-47 **primary subtag**; endonyms carry their own `lang` attribute (WCAG 3.1.2), as `AxisBar.astro` already does. Brand values (entity, address, support addresses) are the exception and must **not** be translated.
5. **WCAG AA** — `--color-accent` `#ec3013` is 3.76:1 on `--color-bg` and fails as small text today in three shipped components plus one on #493. Fixed in Wave D2. New pages must never use `var(--color-accent)` for text under 18.66px; the 006 backlog adds `web/src/styles/accent-usage.test.ts` to make "accent base is ring-only" a gate rather than a note, with an allowlist for the genuine large-text wordmarks (`Masthead.astro`, `a/[id].astro`).
6. **The crawler gate** — `web/src/middleware.ts` 403s crawler user-agents, serves disallow-all `robots.txt`, and stamps `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow` with `Vary: User-Agent` on every response. Correct and harmless for a QR-code pilot: **leave it exactly as it is**, and name it in `checklists/launch-readiness.md` so nobody discovers on 1 October that they assumed the pilot page was searchable.
7. **Two gates the plan adds** — a `web/src/i18n/cashback.test.ts` assertion that no `CashbackStrings` key is unreferenced; and the D3 end-to-end journey test against real Postgres, which is the feature's acceptance criterion rather than a nice-to-have.
8. **Regeneration gates** — `brand.types.ts` is generated from `brand.go` (regenerate, never hand-edit); the sqlc-drift job catches a stale `internal/content/store/`; `internal/content/http_contract_test.go` tests against `specs/001-epiloyes-alpha/contracts/http-api.md`, so the contract document moves **before** the handler.

For 006's dark theme it must change **first and alone**: `token()` becomes block-aware (slice the sheet at rule boundaries before matching, because `String.match` with a non-global regex returns the first occurrence), and gains a one-level `var()` resolver so `--color-bg: var(--paper)` yields `#f3f2f2` and `mixOver()` still parses a mix built from a `var()`. Then add the ten dark ratios and the **two refusals as negative assertions**. A dark block landed before this ships entirely unasserted while the gate stays green.

# Build the epiloYES UI from the design canvas

> **Revised 2026-09-05 after a 16-agent grounding pass.** Three corrections to the
> first version are marked **[CORRECTED]**. The most important: member authentication
> is **already built** on the Go side — the first version said it was not wired.

## Context

You have a 26-artboard Claude Design canvas, **"epiloYES in evreos"**
(`claude.ai/code/artifact/059a20a9-…`, updated 2026-09-04), and you are satisfied with
it. It is the first complete visual design this project has ever had in one place.
This plan turns it into buildable work.

**The canvas is the only copy of the design, and it is outside the repository.**
Twenty-four call sites cite mockups by ID — `Masthead.astro` "mockup 1a",
`ReaderLayout.astro` "the mockups' 1280 canvas", five commits on `xcoder/cashback-web`
reading "rebuild the wallet to mockup 4a (#229)". None is in version control. The
vendored `modernist.css` names an upstream project (`_ds/modernist-2f5ef9ba-…`) that
does not exist on this machine either.

**Most of the canvas is not this repository's work.** It draws epiloYES *inside the
evreos shell*. `docs/master-prompts/evreos-browser.md` opens: "Planning artifact only.
Nothing in this file is in scope for `apivo-news`."

**Your checkout is 773 commits stale.** Local `main` is `7a20f38`; `origin/main` is
`20de06c`. `git pull --ff-only` is step zero.

## Decisions taken (2026-09-05)

1. **Shell artboards → contract only, here.** No shell code in `apivo-news`.
2. **PR #493 merges first**, canvas differences follow as small issues.
3. **Member auth is in scope** — but see the correction below: less remains than feared.
4. **1 October holds.** Sequence backwards from the partner pilot.

---

## The three findings that reshape the plan

### 1. [CORRECTED] Member authentication already exists — on the backend

`internal/identity/{verifier,service,role}.go` verifies Supabase JWTs and resolves the
subject to an `account` row. `internal/cashback/{wallet,clickout,catalogue,payout,ops}/auth.go`
each gate every route behind a `MemberAuthenticator` that takes the member **from the
token, never from the path**. `cmd/apivo/main.go` wires all of it.

The first version of this plan called member auth "not wired" and made it a multi-week
phase. That was wrong: I had grepped the frontend only. What is actually missing is
narrower and sharper:

- **The browser half** — there is no `web/src/lib/member/session.ts`. Days, not weeks.
- **Account-row provisioning** — `git grep "insert into account" origin/main -- internal`
  matches only `_test.go` files. A member who signs up with Supabase today gets a
  cryptographically valid token and `identity.ErrUnknownAccount` → **401 everywhere**.
  This is the real blocker, and it is a *security* task: `account.role` gates article
  approval (I-1) and payout approval (C-4, tightened by migration 0019), so the
  provisioned row must hold neither `editor` nor `operator`, with a test that says so.

### 2. [NEW] `BRAND_DIR` gates the money path — the legal texts are on the critical path

`cmd/apivo/main.go:777` logs, verbatim: *"BRAND_DIR is unset, so this deployment has no
brand definition: members cannot opt into cashback and POST
/api/v1/cashback/participation will answer 503"*, and the loader fails outright when the
brand defines no terms document.

The legal documents are therefore not a compliance chore running beside the product —
**they are a precondition of cashback opt-in, enforced today.** No brand → no opt-in →
no wallet → nothing to sign into. Commissioning the three legal texts is the longest
pole in the whole plan and the only critical-path item no agent can produce.

### 3. [NEW] PR #493 authenticates the member wallet as the *editor*

`web/src/pages/[lang]/[place]/cashback/wallet.astro:73` is
`const session = editorSession(Astro.request);` and line 85 passes `session.token` to
the cashback API. `editorSession` is documented as "the editor identity behind the
editorial screens".

Merge #493 — it is the only copy of the member cashback UI — but **file this as a
security issue and land the fix as the very next PR, and do not publicly deploy the
cashback routes in between.** If the member session is not ready, the interim is to make
the route refuse rather than authenticate as an editor.

---

## Verified state of play

| Area | Reality |
|---|---|
| Frontend | Astro 7 SSR, TS strictest. **No Tailwind, no islands, no state lib.** Tokens in `web/src/styles/modernist.css`. Only client dep is `driver.js`. Forms are plain GET/POST. |
| Pages on `main` | 16. Cashback UI (8 screens + `OpsLayout` + 4 components + `i18n/cashback.ts`) is **not** on main — it is open **PR #493**, ~9.7k lines. |
| Cashback backend | Fully on `main`: migrations `0010`–`0033`, `internal/cashback/*`, `internal/platform/{money,brand,events,scheduler}`. |
| Brand config | `internal/platform/brand/brand.go` → generated `web/src/lib/brand/brand.types.ts`. **Only the fictional Swedish "Zephyra" fixture exists.** `web/src/lib/brand/index.ts` deliberately never reads files — "that belongs to the caller" — so a loader is missing. |
| Theme | Light only. `contrast.test.ts:16` uses a **non-global** `css.match(...)` — first match wins, so a dark block would leave it silently asserting the light palette. |
| Consent | `web/src/lib/account/consent.ts` built and tested; its own header says *"No endpoint exists … This module is the seam."* `setConsent()` returns `{recorded:false}` unconditionally. |
| Legal pages | Do not exist. `SiteFooter.astro` renders "Imprint · Privacy · Contact — *still owed*" as dead text. Issue **#64 is closed as completed** — wrongly. |
| Brand lint | `scripts/lint-brand-literals.sh` + `.github/workflows/brand-lint.yml`. `modernist.css` sits at **39 of 39** hex lines with zero headroom. **A file with no budget entry fails on its first hit** — so every new page here must be literal-free from its first commit. |
| Crawler gate | Global in `web/src/middleware.ts`: UA denylist, disallow-all `robots.txt`, `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow`. New routes inherit it. Correct for a QR pilot — leave it alone, but name it on the launch checklist. |
| Languages | `READING_LANGUAGES = ['el','de']`. Zephyra's `sv`/SEK defaults resolve against nothing. |
| Spec-kit | `001` (T001–T035), `002` (CB-T001–T147), `003-cashback-claims` (T148–T192, arrives with #493, blocked on an amendment), `004` (T200–**T294**, live: 9 done / 59 open). `create-new-feature.sh` creates a directory only — **no git branch** — so refs stay `xcoder/<slug>`. |

---

## 1. Scope boundary — 26 artboards

**17 apivo-news · 6 wholly evreos · 2 mixed · 1 documentation.**

- **Wholly evreos, build nothing ever (6):** LauncherClosed, LauncherOpen,
  LauncherDesktop, HomeMobile, HomeDesktop, Assistant. The constitution's out-of-scope
  list is a **do-not-scaffold** list, not a not-yet list. This also refuses the
  `Αναζήτηση` (search) rail item drawn on NewsDesktop.
- **Mixed, module side only (2):** `Main.dc.html` — the seam. Three of its eight
  contract items are **already built and must be re-exported, never restated**: `Money`
  (`lib/cashback/money.ts`), `Axes` (`lib/reader/axes.ts`), deep links
  (`lib/cashback/paths.ts`). The other five become ADR 0006, not code.
  `AssistantDraft.dc.html` — columns 1 and 3 are evreos's; **column 2 is real work**:
  `withdraw.astro` renders only `t.approvalStep2`, while `approvalStep1` and
  `approvalStep3` sit catalogued in `el` and `de` and referenced nowhere.
- **Documentation, never a route (1):** `SettingsSeam.dc.html` → ADR 0007.
- **apivo-news (17):** 4 built on main (news/article ×2) · 5 built on #493 (wallet,
  catalogue, merchant ×2 + desktop) · 6 boards → 5 new routes (SignIn, Profile +
  ProfileDesktop as one route, Settings, LegalDesktop, Faq) · 2 design-system
  (Palette, Theme).

**The pilot cut — 6 in, 11 deferred.** In: LegalDesktop, SignIn, WalletMobile,
CatalogueMobile, MerchantMobile, WalletDesktop (approval-disclosure box only).

The assistant's hard stop needs **no code and is already true**:
`0014_cashback_payout.up.sql` declares `approved_by uuid not null references
public.account(id)`, tightened to the operator role by 0019. An assistant that is not
an account row *cannot* approve a payout — Postgres refuses, not a policy. The only
action is a thing never to do: never insert a machine row into `public.account`.

## 2. [CORRECTED] Spec-kit structure — two features, not one

The first version proposed a single `005-member-surfaces` with tasks `T300+`. Two
changes, both for good reasons:

- **Two features.** One feature would put a legally-gated money path behind a CSS token
  swap. The hard date splits them cleanly.
- **Letter-prefixed task ids.** `T300+` is a hostage to feature 004, which is live at
  T200–T294 with 59 open tasks and `speckit-converge` free to append. Use the `CB-`
  precedent: `PILOT-T001…` and `DS-T001…`.

### Feature 005 — `specs/005-pilot-launch`, milestone `M-PILOT`

**Acceptance criterion, one sentence:** *A German patient scans a QR code at the
counter, creates an account, accepts the terms, opts into cashback, clicks out to the
partner, and sees a pending entry in a wallet authenticated as them.*

In scope: a real brand definition deployed as `BRAND_DIR`; the browser half of the
existing Supabase session; account-row provisioning; terms acceptance and cashback
opt-in; the legal pages that render the accepted documents; the four cashback member
screens from #493 corrected for phone; the four accent WCAG fixes; one end-to-end
journey test against real Postgres.

Out of scope: dark theme, `/profile`, `/faq`, `/settings` as a route, place chips,
category chips, the wallet timeline, search, claims, everything evreos.

Artefacts: `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `research.md` (the two reshaping findings above),
`data-model.md` (**state explicitly that no migration is expected**),
`contracts/http-api.md`, `quickstart.md` (the counter runbook), `tasks.md`,
`checklists/legal-readiness.md`, `checklists/launch-readiness.md`.

### Feature 006 — `specs/006-design-system`, milestone `M-DESIGN`

Specified during the pilot sprint, **implemented from 2 October**: Palette, Theme,
`/profile`, `/settings`, `/faq`, the news-board deltas.

Its internal ordering is a correctness requirement, not a preference:
1. `contrast.test.ts` made block-aware plus a one-level `var()` resolver, as a **pure
   refactor** — every existing light assertion passing byte-for-byte, no stylesheet
   change in the same PR.
2. Hoist `--paper`/`--ink` primitives **in place** so the hex-line count stays at 39;
   verify with `sh scripts/lint-brand-literals.sh` before committing.
3. The dark block written entirely as `var()` re-assignments, zero new hex literals.
4. The dark ratio assertions, **including two negative ones** (accent-500 on dark
   surface < 4.5; accent-600 on dark bg < 4.5).

A dark block landed before step 1 ships entirely unasserted while the gate stays green.

### Documents — one small PR each, no feature

- `docs/adr/0006-module-shell-seam.md` — the eight contract items; the three already
  satisfied by shipped code; the **unreconciled** inset arithmetic (44/74 on Main vs
  92/98 on the launcher boards — record the ambiguity, do not resolve it). Its opening
  line must state the evreos column is an assumption recorded unilaterally, or it will
  later be cited as though evreos agreed. Two board corrections: the engine question is
  already answered at `evreos-browser.md:296` (WebView2 / WKWebView / WebKitGTK via
  `wry`/`tao`) and what is open is a minimum-version QA matrix; and `:has()` is
  load-bearing in `modernist.css` **and eight page files**, not only shared chrome.
- `docs/adr/0007-settings-across-the-shell-seam.md` — the ownership split: **the shell
  owns the person and the device; the module owns the reading and the money.**
- `docs/design/` — vendor the 26 `.dc.html` boards + `canvas.json` + an index mapping
  board → route → old mockup id, so the 24 dangling "mockup 1a"/"4a" comments resolve.
- `docs/design/canvas-errata.md` — rule at the top: **where a board and a fixture
  disagree, the fixture wins and the board gets corrected.** Six independent analyses
  each caught a different mismatch: `4 καταχωρίσεις` vs five `ENTRY_FIXTURES`;
  `6 νέα σήμερα` vs three el/munich items; `4 συγκαταθέσεις` vs three consent fixtures;
  a 4% rate on a `WalletEntry` that carries no rate field; `naftemporia.example` →
  `aigaionea.example`; `πριν 2 ώρες` vs what `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat` renders;
  `brand.payout` is `{descriptor}` and does **not** carry the threshold (that is
  `WalletTotals.payout_threshold`). Land this early, or an agent will edit
  `fixtures.ts` to make a mockup true.

### Invocation sequence

```sh
/speckit-constitution        # batched PATCH (Q1 Awin+Linkwise) + MINOR (claims, C-8..C-10), one act
/speckit-specify  "Pilot launch on the existing web surfaces: a partner-referred German
                   member registers, accepts terms, opts into cashback, clicks out and
                   sees a pending entry."        # auto-numbers 005; do NOT pass --number
/speckit-clarify             # run AFTER founder decision 1 is answered
/speckit-plan
/speckit-tasks               # then hand-edit ids to the PILOT- prefix
/speckit-checklist "legal readiness: Impressum, privacy notice, terms, retention"
/speckit-checklist "launch readiness: the 25 September freeze gate"
/speckit-analyze
/speckit-taskstoissues       # ONE PHASE AT A TIME — 004 already has 59 open issues
```

## 3. Build order — 26 days

**Day 0, founder-serial, blocks everything.** Answer decision 1. Commission the three
legal texts. Supply the business facts.

**Wave A — days 1–4, four parallel worktree agents.**
A1 merge PR #493 as-is (do not restyle first). A2 immediately behind it, replace
`editorSession(Astro.request)` at `wallet.astro:73` — a security issue, not a design
task. A3 the brand loader: new `web/src/lib/brand/load.ts` + test, resolved once in
`middleware.ts` onto `Astro.locals.brand`. A4 brand schema fields for the
commercial-register/VAT identifier and the §18 MStV responsible person, then
`go test ./internal/platform/brand/ -run TypeScriptDeclaration -update` — never
hand-edit `brand.types.ts`.

**Wave B — days 3–9, inherently sequential, one agent, four ordered PRs.**
(1) `web/src/lib/member/session.ts` mirroring `editorial/session.ts`, including its
refusal to invent a placeholder name; resolved in middleware where identity already
resolves. (2) `/[lang]/signin` plus wiring the existing `/[lang]/register` form (every
field is `disabled` today), both mirroring `editor/signin.astro`'s POST → redirect → GET
shape and its `isSameOrigin` check. (3) **Account-row provisioning** — the security task
above. (4) Rewire wallet, withdraw, catalogue and click-out to carry the member's token.

**Days 4–8, parallel — the brand directory.** Author `brand.json` (`defaults.language:
"de"`, `defaults.place: "munich"`, `defaults.currency: "EUR"`), validate through the
existing `parseBrand`, set `BRAND_DIR`. **Gate: `POST /api/v1/cashback/participation`
must stop answering 503.**

**Wave C — days 8–16, three parallel agents.**
C1 the legal pages: every value from `Astro.locals.brand`, never a literal and never a
catalogue string; `documents['privacy']` may be absent and must render without a version
line rather than printing `undefined`; then replace the dead `<span>`s in
`SiteFooter.astro` with real anchors, delete `— {t.legalPending}`, update
`SiteFooter.test.ts` (it asserts the dead-text shape), and reopen #64.
C2 opt-in and terms acceptance, recording the accepted document version — plus raising
004's **T254** to the top of 004's own queue: click-out does not today refuse a member
who never opted in, so a signed-in member with no participation can be credited.
C3 the two honest disclosures: the merchant page's stated-unknown confirmation band
(`t.confirmationTimeUnknown` is catalogued and referenced nowhere) plus `t.rateAtClick`;
and the withdraw page's three-line approval box, retiring the dead `approvalStep1/3`.

**Wave D — days 14–22, three parallel agents.**
D1 the phone pass for a 40+ cohort: the merchant rate table becomes a prose band under
660px; the wallet hero states `belowThreshold` plus a shortfall from a new
integer-minor-unit `shortfall()` in `money.ts` that throws on currency mismatch exactly
as `sum()` does — never a float, never a decimal parsed back out of formatted text.
D2 the four accent-as-small-text WCAG 1.4.3 fixes to `var(--color-accent-700)`:
`SiteFooter.astro:115`, `EditorChrome.astro:171` and `:196`, `CashbackBar.astro .link.on`.
`contrast.test.ts` misses these because it asserts accent only at the 3:1 non-text floor.
D3 **the end-to-end journey test against real Postgres** — QR URL → register → sign in →
accept terms → opt in → catalogue → tracked click-out → pending entry in a wallet
authenticated as that member. **This test is the acceptance criterion.**

**Days 20–24.** Seed the partner's merchant, route and rate band. Confirm the ops queues
are reachable by an operator-role account. Write the counter runbook. Rehearse the QR
path on real phones on the shop's own network.

**25 September — FREEZE.** Defect fixes only. Nothing from 006 crosses this line.

**Throughout.** Feature 004 continues untouched; nothing here edits
`internal/cashback/networks/`, `cmd/apivo/registry.go` or the config surface 004 is
rewriting, and `PILOT-` cannot collide with T200–T294. The single intersection is T254,
being *prioritised, not moved*.

## 4. Per-screen task shape

Every new screen is the same small commits: strings module + its `.test.ts` (`el` and
`de`, keyed by the language axis, never a locale) → **add the module to
`coverage.include` in `web/vitest.config.ts` in the same commit** (its own comment is a
build instruction; unlisted files are invisible to the 80% gate) → the `.astro` page
taking every value from `modernist.css` variables → any Go endpoint with the test
asserting the *database* refuses → wire into `SiteFooter.astro` → a `data-tour` anchor
if it joins a tour.

- **`/[lang]/signin`** builds on `editor/signin.astro`'s working POST/redirect/GET and
  `isSameOrigin`; reuses `t.signIn`, `t.signInPending`, `t.emailLabel`,
  `t.registrationPending`, all already in both catalogues. Do **not** grow a sign-out —

5. **Ratify the batched constitution amendment** in one act (PATCH: Q1 Awin+Linkwise,

6. **Confirm the cut list** so it is not relitigated in week three.

9. **The §18 MStV responsible person for editorial content.** This product publishes

10. **The commercial-register or VAT identifier**, which depends on the jurisdiction in 2.
11. **The retention schedule** the privacy notice must state.
12. **The freeze date. Working default: 25 September.** A freeze on 30 September is not

13. **Wordmark colour sign-off** — the accessibility answer is not in doubt, but

**Risks, most decisive first.**
1. The pilot may be constitutionally unshippable as described — ask decision 1 today.
2. Legal-text latency sits on the money path, because no brand means a 503 on opt-in.
3. PR #493 is large, unmerged, and carries an authorisation defect.

# Build the epiloYES UI from the design canvas

> **Revised 2026-09-05 after a 16-agent grounding pass.** Three corrections to the
> first version are marked **[CORRECTED]** / **[NEW]**. The most important: member
> authentication is **already built** on the Go side — the first version said it was
> not wired.

## Context

You have a 26-artboard Claude Design canvas, **"epiloYES in evreos"**
(`claude.ai/code/artifact/059a20a9-…`, updated 2026-09-04), and you are satisfied with
it. It is the first complete visual design this project has ever had in one place.
This plan turns it into buildable work.

**The canvas is the only copy of the design, and it is outside the repository.**
Twenty-four call sites cite mockups by ID — `Masthead.astro` "mockup 1a",
`ReaderLayout.astro` "the mockups' 1280 canvas", five commits on `xcoder/cashback-web`
reading "rebuild the wallet to mockup 4a (#229)". None is in version control. The
vendored `modernist.css` names an upstream project (`_ds/modernist-2f5ef9ba-…`) that
does not exist on this machine either.

**Most of the canvas is not this repository's work.** It draws epiloYES *inside the
evreos shell*. `docs/master-prompts/evreos-browser.md` opens: "Planning artifact only.
Nothing in this file is in scope for `apivo-news`."

**Your checkout is 773 commits stale.** Local `main` is `7a20f38`; `origin/main` is
`20de06c`. `git pull --ff-only` is step zero.

## Decisions taken (2026-09-05)

1. **Shell artboards → contract only, here.** No shell code in `apivo-news`.
2. **PR #493 merges first**, canvas differences follow as small issues.
3. **Member auth is in scope** — but see the correction below: less remains than feared.
4. **1 October holds.** Sequence backwards from the partner pilot.

---

## The three findings that reshape the plan

### 1. [CORRECTED] Member authentication already exists — on the backend

`internal/identity/{verifier,service,role}.go` verifies Supabase JWTs and resolves the
subject to an `account` row. `internal/cashback/{wallet,clickout,catalogue,payout,ops}/auth.go`
each gate every route behind a `MemberAuthenticator` that takes the member **from the
token, never from the path**. `cmd/apivo/main.go` wires all of it.

The first version of this plan called member auth "not wired" and made it a multi-week
phase. That was wrong — I had grepped the frontend only. What is actually missing is
narrower and sharper:

- **The browser half** — there is no `web/src/lib/member/session.ts`. Days, not weeks.
- **Account-row provisioning** — `git grep "insert into account" origin/main -- internal`
  matches only `_test.go` files. A member who signs up with Supabase today gets a
  cryptographically valid token and `identity.ErrUnknownAccount` → **401 everywhere**.
  This is the real blocker, and it is a *security* task: `account.role` gates article
  approval (I-1) and payout approval (C-4, tightened by migration 0019), so the
  provisioned row must hold neither `editor` nor `operator`, with a test that says so.

### 2. [NEW] `BRAND_DIR` gates the money path — the legal texts are on the critical path

`cmd/apivo/main.go:777` logs, verbatim: *"BRAND_DIR is unset, so this deployment has no
brand definition: members cannot opt into cashback and POST
/api/v1/cashback/participation will answer 503"*, and the loader fails outright when the
brand defines no terms document.

The legal documents are therefore not a compliance chore running beside the product —
**they are a precondition of cashback opt-in, enforced today.** No brand → no opt-in →
no wallet → nothing to sign into. Commissioning the three legal texts is the longest
pole in the plan and the only critical-path item no agent can produce.

### 3. [NEW] PR #493 authenticates the member wallet as the *editor*

`web/src/pages/[lang]/[place]/cashback/wallet.astro:73` is
`const session = editorSession(Astro.request);` and line 85 passes `session.token` to
the cashback API. `editorSession` is documented as "the editor identity behind the
editorial screens".

Merge #493 — it is the only copy of the member cashback UI — but **file this as a
security issue and land the fix as the very next PR, and do not publicly deploy the
cashback routes in between.** If the member session is not ready, the interim is to make
the route refuse rather than authenticate as an editor.

---

## Verified state of play

| Area | Reality |
|---|---|
| Frontend | Astro 7 SSR, TS strictest. **No Tailwind, no islands, no state lib.** Tokens in `web/src/styles/modernist.css`. Only client dep is `driver.js`. Forms are plain GET/POST. |
| Pages on `main` | 16. Cashback UI (8 screens + `OpsLayout` + 4 components + `i18n/cashback.ts`) is **not** on main — it is open **PR #493**, ~9.7k lines. |
| Cashback backend | Fully on `main`: migrations `0010`–`0033`, `internal/cashback/*`, `internal/platform/{money,brand,events,scheduler}`. |
| Brand config | `internal/platform/brand/brand.go` → generated `web/src/lib/brand/brand.types.ts`. **Only the fictional Swedish "Zephyra" fixture exists.** `web/src/lib/brand/index.ts` deliberately never reads files — "that belongs to the caller" — so a loader is missing. |
| Theme | Light only. `contrast.test.ts:16` uses a **non-global** `css.match(...)` — first match wins, so a dark block would leave it silently asserting the light palette. |
| Consent | `web/src/lib/account/consent.ts` built and tested; its own header says *"No endpoint exists … This module is the seam."* `setConsent()` returns `{recorded:false}` unconditionally. |
| Legal pages | Do not exist. `SiteFooter.astro` renders "Imprint · Privacy · Contact — *still owed*" as dead text. Issue **#64 is closed as completed** — wrongly. |
| Brand lint | `scripts/lint-brand-literals.sh` + `.github/workflows/brand-lint.yml`. `modernist.css` sits at **39 of 39** hex lines with zero headroom. **A file with no budget entry fails on its first hit** — so every new page here must be literal-free from its first commit. |
| Crawler gate | Global in `web/src/middleware.ts`: UA denylist, disallow-all `robots.txt`, `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow`. New routes inherit it. Correct for a QR pilot — leave it alone, but name it on the launch checklist. |
| Languages | `READING_LANGUAGES = ['el','de']`. Zephyra's `sv`/SEK defaults resolve against nothing. |
| Spec-kit | `001` (T001–T035), `002` (CB-T001–T147), `003-cashback-claims` (T148–T192, arrives with #493, blocked on an amendment), `004` (T200–**T294**, live: 9 done / 59 open). `create-new-feature.sh` creates a directory only — **no git branch** — so refs stay `xcoder/<slug>`. |

---

## 1. Scope boundary — 26 artboards

**17 apivo-news · 6 wholly evreos · 2 mixed · 1 documentation.**

- **Wholly evreos, build nothing ever (6):** LauncherClosed, LauncherOpen,
  LauncherDesktop, HomeMobile, HomeDesktop, Assistant. The constitution's out-of-scope
  list is a **do-not-scaffold** list, not a not-yet list. This also refuses the
  `Αναζήτηση` (search) rail item drawn on NewsDesktop.
- **Mixed, module side only (2):** `Main.dc.html` — the seam. Three of its eight
  contract items are **already built and must be re-exported, never restated**: `Money`
  (`lib/cashback/money.ts`), `Axes` (`lib/reader/axes.ts`), deep links
  (`lib/cashback/paths.ts`). The other five become ADR 0006, not code.
  `AssistantDraft.dc.html` — columns 1 and 3 are evreos's; **column 2 is real work**:
  `withdraw.astro` renders only `t.approvalStep2`, while `approvalStep1` and
  `approvalStep3` sit catalogued in `el` and `de` and referenced nowhere.
- **Documentation, never a route (1):** `SettingsSeam.dc.html` → ADR 0007.
- **apivo-news (17):** 4 built on main (news/article, mobile + desktop) · 5 built on
  #493 (wallet ×2, catalogue ×2, merchant) · 6 boards → 5 new routes (SignIn, Profile +
  ProfileDesktop as one route, Settings, LegalDesktop, Faq) · 2 design-system
  (Palette, Theme).

**The pilot cut — 6 in, 11 deferred.** In: LegalDesktop, SignIn, WalletMobile,
CatalogueMobile, MerchantMobile, WalletDesktop (approval-disclosure box only).

The assistant's hard stop needs **no code and is already true**:
`0014_cashback_payout.up.sql` declares `approved_by uuid not null references
public.account(id)`, tightened to the operator role by 0019. An assistant that is not
an account row *cannot* approve a payout — Postgres refuses, not a policy. The only
action is a thing never to do: never insert a machine row into `public.account`.

## 2. [CORRECTED] Spec-kit structure — two features, not one

The first version proposed a single `005-member-surfaces` with tasks `T300+`. Two
changes, both for good reasons:

- **Two features.** One feature would put a legally-gated money path behind a CSS token
  swap. The hard date splits them cleanly.
- **Letter-prefixed task ids.** `T300+` is a hostage to feature 004, which is live at
  T200–T294 with 59 open tasks and `speckit-converge` free to append. Use the `CB-`
  precedent: `PILOT-T001…` and `DS-T001…`.

### Feature 005 — `specs/005-pilot-launch`, milestone `M-PILOT`

**Acceptance criterion, one sentence:** *A German patient scans a QR code at the
counter, creates an account, accepts the terms, opts into cashback, clicks out to the
partner, and sees a pending entry in a wallet authenticated as them.*

In scope: a real brand definition deployed as `BRAND_DIR`; the browser half of the
existing Supabase session; account-row provisioning; terms acceptance and cashback
opt-in; the legal pages that render the accepted documents; the four cashback member
screens from #493 corrected for phone; the four accent WCAG fixes; one end-to-end
journey test against real Postgres.

Out of scope: dark theme, `/profile`, `/faq`, `/settings` as a route, place chips,
category chips, the wallet timeline, search, claims, everything evreos.

Artefacts: `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `research.md` (the two reshaping findings above),
`data-model.md` (**state explicitly that no migration is expected**),
`contracts/http-api.md`, `quickstart.md` (the counter runbook), `tasks.md`,
`checklists/legal-readiness.md`, `checklists/launch-readiness.md`.

### Feature 006 — `specs/006-design-system`, milestone `M-DESIGN`

Specified during the pilot sprint, **implemented from 2 October**: Palette, Theme,
`/profile`, `/settings`, `/faq`, the news-board deltas.

Its internal ordering is a correctness requirement, not a preference:

1. `contrast.test.ts` made block-aware plus a one-level `var()` resolver, as a **pure
   refactor** — every existing light assertion passing byte-for-byte, no stylesheet
   change in the same PR.
2. Hoist `--paper`/`--ink` primitives **in place** so the hex-line count stays at 39;
   verify with `sh scripts/lint-brand-literals.sh` before committing.
3. The dark block written entirely as `var()` re-assignments, zero new hex literals.
4. The dark ratio assertions, **including two negative ones** (accent-500 on dark
   surface < 4.5; accent-600 on dark bg < 4.5).

A dark block landed before step 1 ships entirely unasserted while the gate stays green.

### Documents — one small PR each, no feature

- `docs/adr/0006-module-shell-seam.md` — the eight contract items; the three already
  satisfied by shipped code; the **unreconciled** inset arithmetic (44/74 on Main vs
  92/98 on the launcher boards — record the ambiguity, do not resolve it). Its opening
  line must state that the evreos column is an assumption recorded unilaterally, or it
  will later be cited as though evreos agreed. Two board corrections: the engine
  question is already answered at `evreos-browser.md:296` (WebView2 / WKWebView /
  WebKitGTK via `wry`/`tao`) and what is open is a minimum-version QA matrix; and
  `:has()` is load-bearing in `modernist.css` **and eight page files**, not only the
  shared chrome.
- `docs/adr/0007-settings-across-the-shell-seam.md` — the ownership split: **the shell
  owns the person and the device; the module owns the reading and the money.**
- `docs/design/` — vendor the 26 `.dc.html` boards + `canvas.json` + an index mapping
  board → route → old mockup id, so the 24 dangling "mockup 1a"/"4a" comments resolve.
- `docs/design/canvas-errata.md` — rule at the top: **where a board and a fixture
  disagree, the fixture wins and the board gets corrected.** Six independent analyses
  each caught a different mismatch: `4 καταχωρίσεις` vs five `ENTRY_FIXTURES`;
  `6 νέα σήμερα` vs three el/munich items; `4 συγκαταθέσεις` vs three consent fixtures;
  a 4% rate on a `WalletEntry` that carries no rate field; `naftemporia.example` →
  `aigaionea.example`; `πριν 2 ώρες` vs what `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat` renders;
  `brand.payout` is `{descriptor}` and does **not** carry the threshold (that is
  `WalletTotals.payout_threshold`). Land this early, or an agent will edit
  `fixtures.ts` to make a mockup true.

### Invocation sequence

```sh
/speckit-constitution        # batched PATCH (Q1 Awin+Linkwise) + MINOR (claims, C-8..C-10), one act
/speckit-specify  "Pilot launch on the existing web surfaces: a partner-referred German
                   member registers, accepts terms, opts into cashback, clicks out and
                   sees a pending entry."        # auto-numbers 005; do NOT pass --number
/speckit-clarify             # run AFTER founder decision 1 is answered
/speckit-plan
/speckit-tasks               # then hand-edit ids to the PILOT- prefix
/speckit-checklist "legal readiness: Impressum, privacy notice, terms, retention"
/speckit-checklist "launch readiness: the 25 September freeze gate"
/speckit-analyze
/speckit-taskstoissues       # ONE PHASE AT A TIME — 004 already has 59 open issues
```

## 3. Build order — 26 days

**Day 0, founder-serial, blocks everything.** Answer decision 1. Commission the three
legal texts. Supply the business facts.

**Wave A — days 1–4, four parallel worktree agents.**
A1 merge PR #493 as-is (do not restyle first). A2 immediately behind it, replace
`editorSession(Astro.request)` at `wallet.astro:73` — a security issue, not a design
task. A3 the brand loader: new `web/src/lib/brand/load.ts` + test, resolved once in
`middleware.ts` onto `Astro.locals.brand`. A4 brand schema fields for the
commercial-register/VAT identifier and the §18 MStV responsible person, then
`go test ./internal/platform/brand/ -run TypeScriptDeclaration -update` — never
hand-edit `brand.types.ts`.

**Wave B — days 3–9, inherently sequential, one agent, four ordered PRs.**
(1) `web/src/lib/member/session.ts` mirroring `editorial/session.ts`, including its
refusal to invent a placeholder name; resolved in middleware where identity already
resolves. (2) `/[lang]/signin` plus wiring the existing `/[lang]/register` form (every
field is `disabled` today), both mirroring `editor/signin.astro`'s POST → redirect → GET
shape and its `isSameOrigin` check. (3) **Account-row provisioning** — the security task
above. (4) Rewire wallet, withdraw, catalogue and click-out to carry the member's token.

**Days 4–8, parallel — the brand directory.** Author `brand.json` (`defaults.language:
"de"`, `defaults.place: "munich"`, `defaults.currency: "EUR"`), validate through the
existing `parseBrand`, set `BRAND_DIR`. **Gate: `POST /api/v1/cashback/participation`
must stop answering 503.**

**Wave C — days 8–16, three parallel agents.**
C1 the legal pages: every value from `Astro.locals.brand`, never a literal and never a
catalogue string; `documents['privacy']` may be absent and must render without a version
line rather than printing `undefined`; then replace the dead `<span>`s in
`SiteFooter.astro` with real anchors, delete `— {t.legalPending}`, update
`SiteFooter.test.ts` (it asserts the dead-text shape), and reopen #64.
C2 opt-in and terms acceptance, recording the accepted document version — plus raising
004's **T254** to the top of 004's own queue: click-out does not today refuse a member
who never opted in, so a signed-in member with no participation can be credited.
C3 the two honest disclosures: the merchant page's stated-unknown confirmation band
(`t.confirmationTimeUnknown` is catalogued and referenced nowhere) plus `t.rateAtClick`;
and the withdraw page's three-line approval box, retiring the dead `approvalStep1/3`.

**Wave D — days 14–22, three parallel agents.**
D1 the phone pass for a 40+ cohort: the merchant rate table becomes a prose band under
660px; the wallet hero states `belowThreshold` plus a shortfall from a new
integer-minor-unit `shortfall()` in `money.ts` that throws on currency mismatch exactly
as `sum()` does — never a float, never a decimal parsed back out of formatted text.
D2 the four accent-as-small-text WCAG 1.4.3 fixes to `var(--color-accent-700)`:
`SiteFooter.astro:115`, `EditorChrome.astro:171` and `:196`, `CashbackBar.astro .link.on`.
`contrast.test.ts` misses these because it asserts accent only at the 3:1 non-text floor.
D3 **the end-to-end journey test against real Postgres** — QR URL → register → sign in →
accept terms → opt in → catalogue → tracked click-out → pending entry in a wallet
authenticated as that member. **This test is the acceptance criterion.**

**Days 20–24.** Seed the partner's merchant, route and rate band. Confirm the ops queues
are reachable by an operator-role account. Write the counter runbook. Rehearse the QR
path on real phones on the shop's own network.

**25 September — FREEZE.** Defect fixes only. Nothing from 006 crosses this line.

**Throughout.** Feature 004 continues untouched; nothing here edits
`internal/cashback/networks/`, `cmd/apivo/registry.go` or the config surface 004 is
rewriting, and `PILOT-` cannot collide with T200–T294. The single intersection is T254,
being *prioritised, not moved*.

## 4. Per-screen task shape

Every new screen is the same small commits: strings module + its `.test.ts` (`el` and
`de`, keyed by the language axis, never a locale) → **add the module to
`coverage.include` in `web/vitest.config.ts` in the same commit** (its own comment is a
build instruction; unlisted files are invisible to the 80% gate) → the `.astro` page
taking every value from `modernist.css` variables → any Go endpoint with the test
asserting the *database* refuses → wire into `SiteFooter.astro` → a `data-tour` anchor
if it joins a tour.

- **`/[lang]/signin`** builds on `editor/signin.astro`'s working POST/redirect/GET and
  `isSameOrigin`; reuses `t.signIn`, `t.signInPending`, `t.emailLabel`,
  `t.registrationPending`, all already in both catalogues. Do **not** grow a sign-out —
  ADR 0007 assigns it to the shell — and do not add an `@epiloyes.example` placeholder;
  the lint's `HOST_PATTERN` matches it.
- **The legal pages** — entity, address, jurisdiction and support addresses are brand
  values and **must not be translated**; keep "Impressum · TMG §5" untranslated in the
  `de` catalogue because it cites a statute; all panes render signed-out.
- **The #493 deltas** — keep what the boards subtract: the wallet's four-tab filter row
  and all five entry fixtures (`fx-entry-4` exists because US3 scenario 2 requires the
  credit *and* its reversal to be visible); `t.shopAtTracking` / `t.opensTracked` (the
  board's bare CTA removes the only place a member is told the click is recorded before
  it is recorded); the catalogue's `<label for="q">`. Add a `cashback.test.ts` guard
  that every `CashbackStrings` key is referenced somewhere under `web/src` — the test
  that would have caught `approvalStep1/3` sitting dead.
- **Deferred to 006**, `/settings` is mostly **extraction, not construction**: its
  reading half already ships as `setup.astro`, its consent half already ships inside
  `register.astro` (lift to `ConsentPanel.astro`, keeping the `data-tour` hook
  prop-driven so ProductTour still binds). `/faq` holds answers as **references**, never
  copied sentences — five of the eight already exist verbatim in `i18n/cashback.ts` —
  with a test asserting identity, not similarity.

## 5. Founder decisions still owed

**Blocking engineering — needed in the first 48 hours:**

1. **Is the partner's price-lock offer an ONLINE click-out or an IN-STORE claim?**
   This is the highest-order question and everything is subordinate to it. In-store
   cashback and card-linked offers are on the constitution's out-of-scope list
   (`constitution.md:385`), there is no backend for escrowed partner funding, and
   `specs/003-cashback-claims` is itself blocked on an amendment. **Working default:
   online** — QR at the counter → catalogue → tracked click-out via Awin. If the partner
   has no online storefront on a connected network, say so now: the fallback is sign-up
   plus operator-entered goodwill credits from a named house account, which is a
   different feature, not a schedule change.
2. **Brand facts and the `BRAND_DIR` location** — legal entity, registered address,
   jurisdiction, three support addresses, and the deployment path. Blocks opt-in (503
   today), the legal pages, four screens.
3. **Account provisioning policy.** **Working default: provision on first authenticated
   request, with no role, and a test asserting the row holds neither `editor` nor
   `operator`.** A member who could inherit a role could approve their own withdrawal.
4. **Merge #493 as-is**, wallet auth fix as the next PR, no public deployment between.
   **Working default: yes.**
5. **Ratify the batched constitution amendment** in one act (PATCH: Q1 Awin+Linkwise,
   which 004 says is owed; MINOR: claims + C-8/C-9/C-10, which 003 is blocked on).
6. **Confirm the cut list** so it is not relitigated in week three.
7. **Does the consent write endpoint land inside the sprint?** `setConsent()` returns
   `{recorded:false}` unconditionally and says so. **Working default: no** — the privacy
   notice states what is captured at registration and what is not yet available, which
   is more honest than describing consent management the product cannot perform.

**Blocking launch only:**

8. **The three legal texts** (cashback terms, GDPR privacy notice, TMG §5 Impressum) —
   **the longest pole.** Commission on day one. The code path can be built and tested
   against a private draft brand file from day 4; only the deployed `BRAND_DIR` waits.
   No default is possible: shipping the Zephyra fixture — a Swedish co-operative — to
   German patients is not a trade-off.
9. **The §18 MStV responsible person for editorial content.** This product publishes
   approved articles with named approvers, so the obligation is real.
10. **The commercial-register or VAT identifier**, which depends on the jurisdiction in 2.
11. **The retention schedule** the privacy notice must state.
12. **The freeze date. Working default: 25 September.** A freeze on 30 September is not
    a freeze.
13. **Wordmark colour sign-off** — the accessibility answer is not in doubt, but
    `--color-accent` → `--color-accent-700` visibly changes the footer wordmark, the
    editor chrome and the cashback bar. Do not let an agent land it silently inside a
    larger PR.

## 6. Risks and the cut order

**Risks, most decisive first.**

1. The pilot may be constitutionally unshippable as described — ask decision 1 today.
2. Legal-text latency sits on the money path, because no brand means a 503 on opt-in.
3. PR #493 is large, unmerged, and carries an authorisation defect.
4. Account provisioning touches the table the approval invariants depend on.
5. The privacy notice may claim more than the product can do (decision 7).
6. **Scope creep from the canvas.** The dark theme is self-justifying, visible, and
   consumes the same reviewers as the critical path — while carrying a 39/39 budget
   fight and a test-harness refactor. Every hour on it in September is an hour off the
   chain that closes the pilot.
7. Board numbers becoming contracts — land the errata early.
8. Issue-queue drowning: 004 already has 59 open. Generate 005's issues one phase at a time.
9. **Archivo ships no Greek subset** (#51) — Greek falls to `system-ui`, so the browser
   will not look like the Greek artboards. Decide whether that is acceptable.
10. 13 worktrees pinned to old `xcoder/cb-*` branches and a 773-commit-stale tree.
    Clean up before dispatching agents, or they branch from history.
11. `docs/demo-recording-prompt.md` is untracked and would be lost by `git clean`.

**Cut order.** Items 1–6 are *already* cut in this plan: everything evreos; the dark
theme and the whole Palette/Theme substrate; the typed approver/publication contract
change; `/profile` and `/faq`; `/settings` as a route; place chips, category chips, the
wallet timeline, search, and the four news-board deltas. If the date is still at risk on
15 September, cut next: (7) CatalogueDesktop's toolbar collapse — desktop is not the
pilot's device; (8) the `/[lang]/legal` index page, keeping only `/imprint`, `/privacy`,
`/terms`, `/contact` as deep-linkable routes the footer points at directly.

**Never cut:** the legal three, account provisioning, the wallet auth fix, and the
German copy.

## 7. Verification

- `git pull --ff-only`, then `make vet && make test-unit`.
- Frontend as CI runs it: `cd web && npm ci && npm run check && npm test && npm run build`.
- `sh scripts/lint-brand-literals.sh` — new pages have no budget entry, so any product
  name, domain, support address or hex literal fails on the **first** hit. Put that
  sentence in the body of every issue that creates a page.
- `npx vitest run src/styles/contrast.test.ts` — must keep passing untouched through the
  pilot; it changes first and alone in 006.
- The fixture-brand render test against every new legal and account page.
- `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow` on the new routes — #64's last acceptance criterion.
- Docker is broken here by choice: **CI is the verification of record.** Every PR states
  which checks ran locally and which ran in CI.
- Branches `xcoder/<slug>`, Conventional Commits referencing the issue, one PR per issue,
  signed, no AI attribution. `make ref-lint` and
  `sh scripts/lint-refs.sh --from-messages origin/main..HEAD` before pushing.

# Build the epiloYES UI from the design canvas

> **Revised 2026-09-05 after a 16-agent grounding pass.** Three corrections to the
> first version are marked **[CORRECTED]** / **[NEW]**. The most important: member
> authentication is **already built** on the Go side — the first version said it was
> not wired.

## Context

You have a 26-artboard Claude Design canvas, **"epiloYES in evreos"**
(`claude.ai/code/artifact/059a20a9-…`, updated 2026-09-04), and you are satisfied with
it. It is the first complete visual design this project has ever had in one place.
This plan turns it into buildable work.

**The canvas is the only copy of the design, and it is outside the repository.**
Twenty-four call sites cite mockups by ID — `Masthead.astro` "mockup 1a",
`ReaderLayout.astro` "the mockups' 1280 canvas", five commits on `xcoder/cashback-web`
reading "rebuild the wallet to mockup 4a (#229)". None is in version control. The
vendored `modernist.css` names an upstream project (`_ds/modernist-2f5ef9ba-…`) that
does not exist on this machine either.

**Most of the canvas is not this repository's work.** It draws epiloYES *inside the
evreos shell*. `docs/master-prompts/evreos-browser.md` opens: "Planning artifact only.
Nothing in this file is in scope for `apivo-news`."

**Your checkout is 773 commits stale.** Local `main` is `7a20f38`; `origin/main` is
`20de06c`. `git pull --ff-only` is step zero.

## Decisions taken (2026-09-05)

1. **Shell artboards → contract only, here.** No shell code in `apivo-news`.
2. **PR #493 merges first**, canvas differences follow as small issues.
3. **Member auth is in scope** — but see the correction below: less remains than feared.
4. **1 October holds.** Sequence backwards from the partner pilot.

---

## The three findings that reshape the plan

### 1. [CORRECTED] Member authentication already exists — on the backend

`internal/identity/{verifier,service,role}.go` verifies Supabase JWTs and resolves the
subject to an `account` row. `internal/cashback/{wallet,clickout,catalogue,payout,ops}/auth.go`
each gate every route behind a `MemberAuthenticator` that takes the member **from the
token, never from the path**. `cmd/apivo/main.go` wires all of it.

The first version of this plan called member auth "not wired" and made it a multi-week
phase. That was wrong — I had grepped the frontend only. What is actually missing is
narrower and sharper:

- **The browser half** — there is no `web/src/lib/member/session.ts`. Days, not weeks.
- **Account-row provisioning** — `git grep "insert into account" origin/main -- internal`
  matches only `_test.go` files. A member who signs up with Supabase today gets a
  cryptographically valid token and `identity.ErrUnknownAccount` → **401 everywhere**.
  This is the real blocker, and it is a *security* task: `account.role` gates article
  approval (I-1) and payout approval (C-4, tightened by migration 0019), so the
  provisioned row must hold neither `editor` nor `operator`, with a test that says so.

### 2. [NEW] `BRAND_DIR` gates the money path — the legal texts are on the critical path

`cmd/apivo/main.go:777` logs, verbatim: *"BRAND_DIR is unset, so this deployment has no
brand definition: members cannot opt into cashback and POST
/api/v1/cashback/participation will answer 503"*, and the loader fails outright when the
brand defines no terms document.

The legal documents are therefore not a compliance chore running beside the product —
**they are a precondition of cashback opt-in, enforced today.** No brand → no opt-in →
no wallet → nothing to sign into. Commissioning the three legal texts is the longest
pole in the plan and the only critical-path item no agent can produce.

### 3. [NEW] PR #493 authenticates the member wallet as the *editor*

`web/src/pages/[lang]/[place]/cashback/wallet.astro:73` is
`const session = editorSession(Astro.request);` and line 85 passes `session.token` to
the cashback API. `editorSession` is documented as "the editor identity behind the
editorial screens".

Merge #493 — it is the only copy of the member cashback UI — but **file this as a
security issue and land the fix as the very next PR, and do not publicly deploy the
cashback routes in between.** If the member session is not ready, the interim is to make
the route refuse rather than authenticate as an editor.

---

## Verified state of play

| Area | Reality |
|---|---|
| Frontend | Astro 7 SSR, TS strictest. **No Tailwind, no islands, no state lib.** Tokens in `web/src/styles/modernist.css`. Only client dep is `driver.js`. Forms are plain GET/POST. |
| Pages on `main` | 16. Cashback UI (8 screens + `OpsLayout` + 4 components + `i18n/cashback.ts`) is **not** on main — it is open **PR #493**, ~9.7k lines. |
| Cashback backend | Fully on `main`: migrations `0010`–`0033`, `internal/cashback/*`, `internal/platform/{money,brand,events,scheduler}`. |
| Brand config | `internal/platform/brand/brand.go` → generated `web/src/lib/brand/brand.types.ts`. **Only the fictional Swedish "Zephyra" fixture exists.** `web/src/lib/brand/index.ts` deliberately never reads files — "that belongs to the caller" — so a loader is missing. |
| Theme | Light only. `contrast.test.ts:16` uses a **non-global** `css.match(...)` — first match wins, so a dark block would leave it silently asserting the light palette. |
| Consent | `web/src/lib/account/consent.ts` built and tested; its own header says *"No endpoint exists … This module is the seam."* `setConsent()` returns `{recorded:false}` unconditionally. |
| Legal pages | Do not exist. `SiteFooter.astro` renders "Imprint · Privacy · Contact — *still owed*" as dead text. Issue **#64 is closed as completed** — wrongly. |
| Brand lint | `scripts/lint-brand-literals.sh` + `.github/workflows/brand-lint.yml`. `modernist.css` sits at **39 of 39** hex lines with zero headroom. **A file with no budget entry fails on its first hit** — so every new page here must be literal-free from its first commit. |
| Crawler gate | Global in `web/src/middleware.ts`: UA denylist, disallow-all `robots.txt`, `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow`. New routes inherit it. Correct for a QR pilot — leave it alone, but name it on the launch checklist. |
| Languages | `READING_LANGUAGES = ['el','de']`. Zephyra's `sv`/SEK defaults resolve against nothing. |
| Spec-kit | `001` (T001–T035), `002` (CB-T001–T147), `003-cashback-claims` (T148–T192, arrives with #493, blocked on an amendment), `004` (T200–**T294**, live: 9 done / 59 open). `create-new-feature.sh` creates a directory only — **no git branch** — so refs stay `xcoder/<slug>`. |

---

## 1. Scope boundary — 26 artboards

**17 apivo-news · 6 wholly evreos · 2 mixed · 1 documentation.**

- **Wholly evreos, build nothing ever (6):** LauncherClosed, LauncherOpen,
  LauncherDesktop, HomeMobile, HomeDesktop, Assistant. The constitution's out-of-scope
  list is a **do-not-scaffold** list, not a not-yet list. This also refuses the
  `Αναζήτηση` (search) rail item drawn on NewsDesktop.
- **Mixed, module side only (2):** `Main.dc.html` — the seam. Three of its eight
  contract items are **already built and must be re-exported, never restated**: `Money`
  (`lib/cashback/money.ts`), `Axes` (`lib/reader/axes.ts`), deep links
  (`lib/cashback/paths.ts`). The other five become ADR 0006, not code.
  `AssistantDraft.dc.html` — columns 1 and 3 are evreos's; **column 2 is real work**:
  `withdraw.astro` renders only `t.approvalStep2`, while `approvalStep1` and
  `approvalStep3` sit catalogued in `el` and `de` and referenced nowhere.
- **Documentation, never a route (1):** `SettingsSeam.dc.html` → ADR 0007.
- **apivo-news (17):** 4 built on main (news/article, mobile + desktop) · 5 built on
  #493 (wallet ×2, catalogue ×2, merchant) · 6 boards → 5 new routes (SignIn, Profile +
  ProfileDesktop as one route, Settings, LegalDesktop, Faq) · 2 design-system
  (Palette, Theme).

**The pilot cut — 6 in, 11 deferred.** In: LegalDesktop, SignIn, WalletMobile,
CatalogueMobile, MerchantMobile, WalletDesktop (approval-disclosure box only).

The assistant's hard stop needs **no code and is already true**:
`0014_cashback_payout.up.sql` declares `approved_by uuid not null references
public.account(id)`, tightened to the operator role by 0019. An assistant that is not
an account row *cannot* approve a payout — Postgres refuses, not a policy. The only
action is a thing never to do: never insert a machine row into `public.account`.

## 2. [CORRECTED] Spec-kit structure — two features, not one

The first version proposed a single `005-member-surfaces` with tasks `T300+`. Two
changes, both for good reasons:

- **Two features.** One feature would put a legally-gated money path behind a CSS token
  swap. The hard date splits them cleanly.
- **Letter-prefixed task ids.** `T300+` is a hostage to feature 004, which is live at
  T200–T294 with 59 open tasks and `speckit-converge` free to append. Use the `CB-`
  precedent: `PILOT-T001…` and `DS-T001…`.

### Feature 005 — `specs/005-pilot-launch`, milestone `M-PILOT`

**Acceptance criterion, one sentence:** *A German patient scans a QR code at the
counter, creates an account, accepts the terms, opts into cashback, clicks out to the
partner, and sees a pending entry in a wallet authenticated as them.*

In scope: a real brand definition deployed as `BRAND_DIR`; the browser half of the
existing Supabase session; account-row provisioning; terms acceptance and cashback
opt-in; the legal pages that render the accepted documents; the four cashback member
screens from #493 corrected for phone; the four accent WCAG fixes; one end-to-end
journey test against real Postgres.

Out of scope: dark theme, `/profile`, `/faq`, `/settings` as a route, place chips,
category chips, the wallet timeline, search, claims, everything evreos.

Artefacts: `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `research.md` (the two reshaping findings above),
`data-model.md` (**state explicitly that no migration is expected**),
`contracts/http-api.md`, `quickstart.md` (the counter runbook), `tasks.md`,
`checklists/legal-readiness.md`, `checklists/launch-readiness.md`.

### Feature 006 — `specs/006-design-system`, milestone `M-DESIGN`

Specified during the pilot sprint, **implemented from 2 October**: Palette, Theme,
`/profile`, `/settings`, `/faq`, the news-board deltas.

Its internal ordering is a correctness requirement, not a preference:

1. `contrast.test.ts` made block-aware plus a one-level `var()` resolver, as a **pure
   refactor** — every existing light assertion passing byte-for-byte, no stylesheet
   change in the same PR.
2. Hoist `--paper`/`--ink` primitives **in place** so the hex-line count stays at 39;
   verify with `sh scripts/lint-brand-literals.sh` before committing.
3. The dark block written entirely as `var()` re-assignments, zero new hex literals.
4. The dark ratio assertions, **including two negative ones** (accent-500 on dark

A dark block landed before step 1 ships entirely unasserted while the gate stays green.

### Documents — one small PR each, no feature

- `docs/adr/0006-module-shell-seam.md` — the eight contract items; the three already
  satisfied by shipped code; the **unreconciled** inset arithmetic (44/74 on Main vs
  92/98 on the launcher boards — record the ambiguity, do not resolve it). Its opening
  line must state that the evreos column is an assumption recorded unilaterally, or it
  will later be cited as though evreos agreed. Two board corrections: the engine

  WebKitGTK via `wry`/`tao`) and what is open is a minimum-version QA matrix; and
  `:has()` is load-bearing in `modernist.css` **and eight page files**, not only the
  shared chrome.
- `docs/adr/0007-settings-across-the-shell-seam.md` — the ownership split: **the shell
  owns the person and the device; the module owns the reading and the money.**
- `docs/design/` — vendor the 26 `.dc.html` boards + `canvas.json` + an index mapping
  board → route → old mockup id, so the 24 dangling "mockup 1a"/"4a" comments resolve.
- `docs/design/canvas-errata.md` — rule at the top: **where a board and a fixture
  disagree, the fixture wins and the board gets corrected.** Six independent analyses
  each caught a different mismatch: `4 καταχωρίσεις` vs five `ENTRY_FIXTURES`;
  `6 νέα σήμερα` vs three el/munich items; `4 συγκαταθέσεις` vs three consent fixtures;
  a 4% rate on a `WalletEntry` that carries no rate field; `naftemporia.example` →
  `aigaionea.example`; `πριν 2 ώρες` vs what `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat` renders;
  `brand.payout` is `{descriptor}` and does **not** carry the threshold (that is
  `WalletTotals.payout_threshold`). Land this early, or an agent will edit

### Invocation sequence

```sh
/speckit-constitution        # batched PATCH (Q1 Awin+Linkwise) + MINOR (claims, C-8..C-10), one act
/speckit-specify  "Pilot launch on the existing web surfaces: a partner-referred German

/speckit-plan
/speckit-tasks               # then hand-edit ids to the PILOT- prefix

**Day 0, founder-serial, blocks everything.** Answer decision 1. Commission the three

**Wave B — days 3–9, inherently sequential, one agent, four ordered PRs.**

are reachable by an operator-role account. Write the counter runbook. Rehearse the QR
path on real phones on the shop's own network.

**Throughout.** Feature 004 continues untouched; nothing here edits
`internal/cashback/networks/`, `cmd/apivo/registry.go` or the config surface 004 is
rewriting, and `PILOT-` cannot collide with T200–T294. The single intersection is T254,
being *prioritised, not moved*.

## 4. Per-screen task shape

Every new screen is the same small commits: strings module + its `.test.ts` (`el` and
`de`, keyed by the language axis, never a locale) → **add the module to
`coverage.include` in `web/vitest.config.ts` in the same commit** (its own comment is a

  board's bare CTA removes the only place a member is told the click is recorded before
  it is recorded); the catalogue's `<label for="q">`. Add a `cashback.test.ts` guard
  that every `CashbackStrings` key is referenced somewhere under `web/src` — the test
  that would have caught `approvalStep1/3` sitting dead.
- **Deferred to 006**, `/settings` is mostly **extraction, not construction**: its

  `register.astro` (lift to `ConsentPanel.astro`, keeping the `data-tour` hook
  prop-driven so ProductTour still binds). `/faq` holds answers as **references**, never
